name: forge-system
title: Forge product patterns
description: Accessible product patterns for shadcn/ui, including async states, data tables, combo boxes, and Sonner feedback.

files.content:
# Forge patterns

Framework: Next.js. Primitives: shadcn/ui.

Included: ComboBox, EmptyState, ErrorState, SuspenseContainer, DataTable, Sonner toasts.

Public APIs support a class override and the relevant async, disabled, selection, sorting, pagination, and recovery states. DataTable → SuspenseContainer → EmptyState + ErrorState.
